slides.h1: Nearly a quarter of India's branch banking openings carry one title. Axis Bank posts 65.1% of them.
slides.sub: 3,138 frontline roles, read on 9 September 2026 from 220+ MNC career pages.
slides.caption:
If you are starting out in banking, one title covers nearly a quarter of the branch openings we tracked, and one bank posts it.

Our agents read 220+ MNC career pages on 9 September 2026 and pulled close to 23,000 openings. 3,138 of them were frontline sales and branch banking roles in India.

slides.sub: Business Development Associate (RB-LS) at Axis Bank. 24.3% of the lane, every posting entry level, 1.0 year on average.
slides.caption: If you are starting out, start with Business Development Associate. Axis Bank posts all 763 of these openings, and every one is entry level.

slides.kicker: Axis posts the next three titles too
head: Title
Share
slides.note: Titles are the employers' own wording.
slides.caption: Axis posts the next three titles too. Further down come Inbound Sales Representative – Voice at Accenture (1.6%), Relationship Manager – Priority Banking at Axis (1.1%) and Elite Banker – Branch Banking at Kotak Mahindra Bank (0.8%).

slides.kicker: Entry-level share of each place's openings
slides.note: Kolkata asks for 1.7 years on average. Bengaluru asks for 4.3.
slides.caption: If you want an entry-level role, Kolkata asks for the least: 71.4% of openings, at an average minimum of 1.7 years. Bengaluru sits at the other end among the metros, at 25.8% and 4.3 years.

slides.kicker: TWO IN THREE FROM ONE BANK
slides.sub: Axis Bank posted 2,042 of 3,138 openings. Kotak Mahindra Bank posted 10.4%. More than 60 employers share the rest.
slides.caption: Axis Bank posted 65.1% of the lane. Kotak Mahindra Bank posted 10.4%. The remaining 24.5% is spread across more than 60 employers.

slides.kicker: Axis share of each place's openings
slides.note: Outside the big metros the picture flips: Kotak posts 51.9% of those openings.
slides.caption: Axis leads in every big metro, from 62.2% of openings in Mumbai to 89.2% in Kolkata. Outside the big metros, the picture flips: Axis's share is 0.0% and Kotak's is 51.9%. Surat (17), Indore (12) and Rajkot (9) lead the named cities in that group.

slides.sub: The whole skill list reads like a sales job. Mutual funds and general insurance each appear in nearly one in five openings.
slides.caption:
Sales leads by a wide margin, at 54.8% of openings. Banking follows at 40.1%, lead generation at 38.4% and financial services at 37.0%. Product knowledge sits alongside the selling.
